summary: The PR addresses an issue with incorrect (app_label, model) pairs being passed to allow_migrate() during makemigrations consistency checks. The change appears to fix the issue without introducing obvious regressions or other problems.

issues.description: The PR does not include additional tests to verify the fix specifically for the described issue with incorrect (app_label, model) pairs. While the existing tests pass, more targeted tests should be added to ensure the fix works as intended.
